newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico June-June employment up 9.3 pct - Zedillo.
newsitem.headline: Mexico June-June employment up 9.3 pct - Zedillo.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo said on Monday that formal employment rose by 9.3 percent between June 1996 and June 1997.

"From June last year to June this year, the increase in permanent workers (registered) with the Social Security Institute was 9.3 percent," Zedillo said while opening a new industrial park in the central Mexican state of Morelos.
All formally employed Mexican workers in the private sector must be registered with the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS).
The number registered with the IMSS is considered a more accurate measure of permanent employment than Mexico's open unemployment rate, an estimate that includes casual and informal laborers.
